Can I change the payment method on my order?

Once an order is placed and confirmed, the payment method cannot be changed.

If you received an order confirmation email, that means your original payment went through successfully and everything is set on our side. There’s nothing else you need to do regarding payment for that order.

If you were hoping to use a gift card or store credit instead, tell me which one and I can guide you on next steps.
